text_block_list.name: Curren Chan
text_block_list.text:
"Wah~! Is this a birthday present?\nThank 
you so much!"

text_block_list.name: Admire Vega
text_block_list.text:
...Just to let you know, don't get your 
hopes up. I don't have any sense for this 
kind of thing.

text_block_list.name: Curren Chan
text_block_list.text:
Huh? When you put it like that, it 
actually makes me get my hopes—

text_block_list.name: Curren Chan
text_block_list.text:
Wait, huh? Isn't this wrapping paper... 
from a sporting goods store?

text_block_list.name: Admire Vega
text_block_list.text:
...A shoeing hammer. Weren't you just in 
your room wondering if you should buy a 
new one the other day?

text_block_list.name: Admire Vega
text_block_list.text:
"I told you not to get your hopes up. 
...Besides, if you're not gonna use it, I 
will."

text_block_list.name: Curren Chan
text_block_list.text:
Wait, of course I'll use it! I was just 
really surprised!

text_block_list.name: Curren Chan
text_block_list.text:
"...Ayabe-san, you don't lack taste at 
all! Curren's honestly a little jealous!"

text_block_list.name: Curren Chan
text_block_list.text:
Thank you so much for the present! I'll 
cherish it♪

text_block_list.name: Admire Vega
text_block_list.text:
...Use it however you like. It's yours, 
after all.
